== Overview ==

The Nintendo Network eShop services handle title purchasing, metadata, and content management for digitally purchased titles.

The eShop is made up of several distinct services, each responsible for a specific aspect of its functionality:

{| class="wikitable"
! Service !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/eShop/Tagaya|Tagaya]] || Title version list
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/eShop/Geisha|Geisha]] || Wii U eShop interface
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/eShop/Ninja|Ninja]] || eShop metadata API
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/eShop/Samurai|Samurai]] || eShop metadata API
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/SOAP|SOAP]] || Title installation/management
|}
